question_text: On 2025-12-08 (UTC), compare the morning rush window (08:00-10:00) versus the evening rush window (17:00-19:00) at Gate_MainEntrance for total person flow (person_entry + person_exit). Which window was busier and approximately by how much?

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (e:Event) 
  WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T08:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-08T10:00:00Z' 
    AND e.event_type IN ['person_entry', 'person_exit'] 
  MATCH (e)-[:DETECTED_BY]->(:Camera {camera_location: 'Gate_MainEntrance'})
  RETURN count(e) AS morning_rush
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (e:Event) 
  WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T17:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-08T19:00:00Z' 
    AND e.event_type IN ['person_entry', 'person_exit'] 
  MATCH (e)-[:DETECTED_BY]->(:Camera {camera_location: 'Gate_MainEntrance'})
  RETURN count(e) AS evening_rush
}
RETURN 
  CASE 
    WHEN sum(morning_rush) > sum(evening_rush) THEN 'morning' 
    ELSE 'evening' 
  END AS busier_window, 
  abs(sum(morning_rush) - sum(evening_rush)) AS difference
